# Define additional images

This topic describes how to use the `additionalImages` field in the Replicated Application custom resource to include images that are not defined in your application manifests.

## Overview

When you promote a release, the Replicated Vendor Portal builds the release's image list from the images defined in the Pod specs for the release. Any required images that are _not_ defined in your application manifests must be listed in the `additionalImages` attribute of the Replicated Application custom resource. One common use case is Kubernetes Operators, which might pull images at runtime that are not referenced in any manifest.

How the Vendor Portal uses `additionalImages` depends on the installation type:

* **Embedded Cluster, KOTS existing cluster, and kURL installations**: The Vendor Portal includes the images listed in `additionalImages` in the `.airgap` bundle for the release. During installation or upgrade, the installer retags the images from the bundle and pushes them to the local registry.

* **Helm CLI installations**: There is no `.airgap` bundle for Helm installations. Instead, the Vendor Portal adds the images listed in `additionalImages` to the image list for the release, rewritten to use the Replicated proxy registry. The Enterprise Portal and Download Portal use this list to generate the commands that customers run to pull, tag, and push images to their own registry. For more information, see [Install and update with Helm in air gap environments](/vendor/helm-install-airgap).

  The rest of the image list for Helm installations comes from the HelmChart custom resources in the release, so include a HelmChart custom resource for each chart in addition to the Application custom resource. For more information, see [Prerequisites](/vendor/helm-install-airgap#prerequisites) in _Install and update with Helm in air gap environments_.

## Define additional images

You can include the following types of images in the `additionalImages` field:

* Public images referenced by the docker pullable image name.
* Images pushed to a private registry that was configured in the Vendor Portal, referenced by the docker-pullable, upstream image name. For more information about configuring private registries, see [Add and Manage External Registries](/vendor/packaging-private-images).
* Images pushed to the Replicated registry referenced by the `registry.replicated.com` name.

The following example demonstrates adding multiple images to `additionalImages`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kots.io/v1beta1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: my-app
spec:
  additionalImages:
    - elasticsearch:7.6.0
    - quay.io/orgname/private-image:v1.2.3
    - registry.replicated.com/my-operator/my-private-image:abd123f
```

## Images used only by Replicated installers

If an image listed in `additionalImages` is also referenced by a Helm chart or resource that has the `kots.io/installer-only` annotation, and is not referenced anywhere else in the release, the image is left out of the Helm CLI installation instructions. It is still included in the `.airgap` bundle for Embedded Cluster, KOTS, and kURL installations. This lets you ship images for components that only Replicated installers deploy, such as a database chart that is needed only for Embedded Cluster installations. For more information, see [Exclude certain images from Helm CLI install instructions](/vendor/enterprise-portal-configure#installer-only).
